text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
People of Japan, can you see this!?
The incredible feat that <chrname> has achieved!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"She's done it! She's finally done it!
The crown all of Japan has been longing for...!"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...What a magnificent... ngh,
<chrname> has...!

—Some embraced those nearest to them,
while others wept hot tears.

text_block_list.name: Fan from Japan
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>!
...Ngh, that was amazing!

Screaming the name of the one who reached the top of the world.
Until their throat is hoarse, roaring at the top of their lungs.

On this day, <chrname> became
Japan's very first Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe champion.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ""...Oh, heavens, how awful.""

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: "Today, someone other than me went and changed the world."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...And the stage where you can do just that is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "It's a place where you can make your dream of becoming the world's best come true and carve your name in history."

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: "...Yes, that's right."

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, horse girl of Japan.
<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, Trainer <username>.
You two still have a big job left to do.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The world is waiting for you all.
It's telling you to hurry up and lift that trophy!

"With Mei Satake pulling me by the arm,
I head toward the podium alongside <chrname>."

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
You are so amazing!!
Félicitations !

Even while on the move, people from various countries
shower <chrname> with praise.
Applause is offered, handshakes are requested—
All of a sudden, it stopped.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Sorry, sorry.
You're the ones who worked so hard, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Really... it feels like I'm dreaming.
To be able to welcome a sight like this."
choice_data_list: It's because I never stopped dreaming that I'm able to stand here now.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
<chrname>,
Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The podium is just ahead.
Please go ahead and guide your prized Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Go out there, the two of you, and soak in the finest praise.

—Exchanging a glance with <chrname>,
we set off walking once more.

Step by step, together with her,
I climbed the stairs to the podium—
<chrname> hoisted the trophy.

"...I shall follow as well.
Feeling that very weight in the palm of my hand."
choice_data_list: (The title of the best in the world we seized together)

text_block_list.text: Holding the romance I've always wished for close to my heart.
...And the flame is kindled.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
…………I've been thinking for a while now...
That maybe it's time to stop cheering
for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I hated getting my hopes up only to be disappointed.
I hated that instead of praising the girl who tried her best,
I started saying, "I knew she'd lose."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I can't help but dream.
And that's why in the end, I'm cheering for them again this year.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...ah, truly.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... I didn't give up...
Getting to witness this moment...!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"...We'll definitely dream again next year.
Dreaming that 'a Japanese Umamusume will become number one in the world.'"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! Yeah, makes sense.
I wanna see it again, too... the continuation of this dream—
—The fire is lit.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Can I aim to be the best in the world, too?

text_block_list.name: Trainer in the Stands
text_block_list.text: ...You're in for a tough time, you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. Even with that,
I feel like this dream can't be stopped."
—The next flame is lit.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mei. We won the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
The goal of Project L'Arc has been accomplished.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for it for as many years as it takes.
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are children who dream,
our work is never done.
...Will you help me, Yayoi?
—The fire keeps burning.
